# tapectl drill

[All commands](README.md)

Record heir drills (RESTORE.sh run with the stock tools)

```text
tapectl drill [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

**Subcommands**

- [`record`](#tapectl-drill-record) — Record that an heir drill was done on a volume

### tapectl drill record

Record that an heir drill was done on a volume

Run RESTORE.sh from the volume as an heir would, with the stock tools alone, then record it here: the row names the volume, the sha256 of the RESTORE.sh the volume carries (as the catalog recorded it when the volume was written or rebuilt; empty when it never learned it), and the first lines of `tar --version` and `age --version` on this host (empty when a tool is absent). `audit` warns (`drill_age`) when no drill is recorded or the newest is older than `[defaults] drill_interval_days` (365 when absent). A volume of any status may be drilled. Reads no device.

```text
tapectl drill record [OPTIONS] <LABEL>
```

**Arguments**

- `<LABEL>` — Label of the volume drilled

**Options**

- `--note <NOTE>` — A note kept with the record
